title: Invertible object
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, let $\ell$ be a prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and chosen uniformizer $\varpi$, and let $n\geq1$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n\mathcal O_E$ as in [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the small pro-etale site $X_{\Proet}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] or the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with the size convention incorporated in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. On either site write $A_X$ for the constant sheaf of rings [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and also for its complex concentrated in degree zero. Write $D(X_{\Proet},A)$ for the unbounded derived category of sheaves of $A_X$-modules specified in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and $D(X_{\Et},A)$ for that of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Use the derived tensor product $-\otimes^L_{A_X}-$ of [def-weil-derived-tensor] on $D(X_{\Proet},A)$ and that of [def-kun-derived-tensor] on $D(X_{\Et},A)$, each computed with a K-flat resolution of the first factor.

An invertible object of $D(X_{\Proet},A)$ with chosen inverse data is a triple $(L,L',e)$ consisting of objects $L,L'$ and an isomorphism
$$
e:L\otimes^L_{A_X}L'\xrightarrow{\sim}A_X.
$$
One says that $L$ is invertible if such $L',e$ exist. The same definition, including the chosen triple and the existence condition on $L$, is made in $D(X_{\Et},A)$.
